title: Paid-only models get clearer balance rules
summary:
Paid-only model rules got explicit, Moltbot joined the catalog, and SDXL Turbo left the image lineup.

Seven models now require purchased-pack or crypto Pollen; daily tier grants cannot cover their requests. The model API exposes `paid_only`, and Play and Enter label the affected models. Daily tier refills also moved to a scheduled workflow.

The community catalog added @its3li’s Moltbot, a Telegram and WhatsApp assistant using Pollinations, under Social Bots.

The `turbo` image model and its dedicated routing were removed. Self-hosted image routing retains the zimage and Flux pools.
